div.note: Heading only in D (in red; added by the compiler, not in the archetype). Base text K = G (Cotton Nero A I f. 41, c. 1070); N = A (Harley 55, c. 1050); D (CCCC 201 p. 46, c. 1060) is also given here. II Eg is the ecclesiastical half, III Eg the secular half, of the Andover code (959–c. 962).; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads), October 2026 (was “959–c.962; after IV Edg (Robertson); Andover; 959–63 (Whitelock)”, now “959–c.962 (Liebermann); after IV Eg (Robertson); 959–63 (Whitelock); Andover”); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “959–c.962 (Liebermann); after IV Eg (Robertson); 959–63 (Whitelock); Andover”, now “959–c.962 (Liebermann, I p. 194); after IV Eg (Robertson); 959–63 (Whitelock, EHD p. 434); Andover”); BQ: page of each of Liebermann’s texts and of his German, checked against Liebermann, Gesetze I (our double-read transcription), October 2026 (e.g. was “(empty)”, now “D 194; German 195”; 18 rows of II Eg); V: page of the modern editor’s text / translation, checked against Robertson (translation on the facing page), October 2026 (e.g. was “20”, now “20 / 21”; 18 rows of II Eg)
